pr_title: Allow storyboard elements to load textures from skins
pr_body:
~PR is not yet ready for merge.~

~In its current state it only works for sprites and only for custom skins as default skins don't use textures.~ - now it doesn't work for osu!lazer skin, it's fixed for osu!classic

~I don't know how to tackle animations though. [Animation](https://github.com/ppy/osu-framework/blob/master/osu.Framework/Graphics/Animations/Animation.cs) class doesn't expose anything to remove already added frames. DrawableStoryboardAnimation could be changed to inherit DrawableAnimation instead of TextureAnimation and then changing the texture of each Sprite but I think that's suboptimal. Any suggestions appreciated.~ - resolved by framework fix

Preview: https://youtu.be/zLu52AYAJVw

Fixes #8472
pr_comments: It would be nice for `Animation` to expose a `ClearFrames()` method.
What's the intention here? Generally we don't use draft PRs - if you are happy with the state of this please unmark it as a draft.
Ah, I marked it as a draft because animation skinning is not implemented yet as it needs framework fix.
@Wieku are you planning to make the framework change, or should we look at doing that?
~I will look into it this week~
I think it's done. IIRC storyboard samples can't load skin samples in stable, right?

I've started work on getting this finished but it actually turns out there is more to that functionality than given here - the option to fall back to skin sprites is actually modulated by [the `UseSkinSprites` setting](https://osu.ppy.sh/help/wiki/osu!_File_Formats/Osu_(file_format)#general), so going to have to think how to go about supporting this.

Immediate thought is to have the root `Storyboard` DI-able, so that it can be resolved in the sprites/animations to read the setting value, but don't know for sure if it'll work with the current method of construction of the storyboard (I *think* it should, though). I think I also want to add tests for this if feasible.

I think passing it through element controllers also might be a good approach in case storyboarding would be expanded to allow only certain elements to be skinnable. On the other side it may be too far-fetched.

I considered that briefly but seeing that some [beatmap](https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/1130581#osu/2361608) [storyboards](https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/470977#osu/1006822) use tens of thousands of sprites for effects I'm not sure whether incurring that memory cost is worth it.

I've pushed in the changes alongside a simple test scene. Aside from that this can also be tested with the map linked in the video in the OP, which is https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/832364#osu/1743837 (warning - in the latter part the hit circle numbers look wrong, but that is "partly" by design, I think - stable just doesn't show the real ones and shows only the fake ones on the storyboard).

The ugliest part is probably the `DrawableStoryboard{Sprite,Animation}` logic duplication. I wanted to use `DrawableStoryboardSprites` as frames of `DrawableStoryboardAnimation`, but the former has some lifetime logic related to events baked into it and as such wouldn't work (spotted this while debugging why my sprites weren't showing up in the test scene). Unsure if relevant.

I would have also added a test for standard storyboard sprites, just for completeness' sake - I even have one stashed, but it requires having files mirroring our hashed storage setup (so i.e. `a/ab/abcdef`) in one of the test resource folders, so decided against it for now. Can push in on request.

issue_context.title: Storyboards should have access to classic skin files
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 
Beatmaps don't pull sprites from skins.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
No screenshots available, but can be reproduced by attempting to play Supairo's aspire!taiko map "Function Phantom - Algebra" in osu!stable and comparing it to playing in osu!lazer.

**osu!lazer version:** 
2020.327.0

**Logs:**
[database.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4395360/database.log)
[network.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4395361/network.log)
[performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4395362/performance.log)
[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/4395363/runtime.log)
comments: Taiko skins is not implemented yet
Will keep this open as we don't yet have an issue to track this task.

this isn't quite "basic skinning support" in my opinion, as the skin displays properly for playing purposes, but not for storyboarding. not being able to use custom taiko skins is another issue entirely. i wasn't quite clear before, i meant maps couldn't pull even default assets for use in storyboarding
oh, that's a very different thing.
sorry, i wasn't very clear originally

review_comments: does this work as expected without this check? kinda undefined behaviour now.. (the case where `UseSkinSprites == false`)
Good point. While setting a null texture on a sprite is supported as far as I can tell it should probably not happen if it can be avoided.

Yeah it does look to work. Maybe we do want to initialise the sprites regardless thinking forward to storyboard editor implementation? They look to show up in the draw visualiser and behave as normal (but not display due to missing texture).

I think it's fine to leave this way since it doesn't crash or anything.
Actually never mind, will change as i think it improves readability (and what I said doesn't make much sense – this is already encapsulated in a drawable representing the storyboard sprite).
Ended up combining the lookup logic. Feels quite a bit cleaner.
